meta.name: MemeTracker
meta.shortDescription: Track Dogecoin payments to an address (mempool)
meta.longDescription: MemeTracker is a Go-based Dogecoin mempool-only tracker: it does not download blocks or headers, only relayed transactions (P2P mempool + inv/getdata for tx). The web UI includes a dashboard (charts, P2P/mempool stats), tracking P2PKH addresses, listing transactions, peers view, optional API IP allowlist, and Start/Stop for the P2P watcher. DogeBOX env seeds memetracker_config.json on first boot so P2P can auto-start. You may still use GET /track/<P2PKH address> or the API. Parallel P2P sessions (default 3), DNS seeds and shuffled peer IPs improve gossip vs a single connection. For maximum reliability set P2P_HOST to your own Dogecoin Core. Addresses expire after retention days without /track refresh.
